name: Code Review
description: Structured code review with configurable thoroughness

skillFrontmatter.name: code-review
skillFrontmatter.description: Review code for quality, security, and maintainability. Use when reviewing pull requests, examining code changes, or when the user asks for a code review.

bodyTemplate:
# Code Review

## Checklist

- [ ] Logic is correct and handles edge cases
{{#if parameters.checkSecurity}}
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities (injection, XSS, auth bypass)
{{/if}}
- [ ] Code follows project style conventions
- [ ] Functions are appropriately sized and focused
{{#if parameters.checkTests}}
- [ ] Tests cover the changes adequately
{{/if}}
{{#if parameters.deepReview}}
- [ ] Error handling is comprehensive
- [ ] No unnecessary complexity or over-engineering
- [ ] Performance implications considered
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
{{/if}}

## Feedback format

- **Critical**: Must fix before merge
- **Suggestion**: Consider improving
- **Nice to have**: Optional enhancement
